headline: Points carry between matches, disconnects get a grace period, readable lock passwords.
detail:
• Leftover points carry into your next match vs the same opponent (both opt in).
• Mid-match disconnects get a reconnect countdown instead of ending instantly.
• Lock passwords are real words now, not random characters.

headline: The bot detects what you actually took off.
detail: • Clothing removal is read from your wardrobe, not just hand-confirmed — fewer mismatches.

headline: R130 restraints added; new gear flagged 🆕.
detail:
• Added the Cybertech gas mask and Chastity Tunnel Piercings.
• New items sit at the top of their slot list with a 🆕 marker.

headline: Friend the bot to see when it's online; !changelog shows what's new.
detail:
• "Add friend with notification" auto-adds you back — the bot shows in your friends list when online. Whisper !friend if it didn't; !unfriend to undo. Display only, no beeps.
• Update announcements are one headline now, not a wall of text — whisper !changelog for full history.

headline: Blocked padlocks are caught right after a challenge.
detail: • If you've blocked the Timer Password Padlock, I flag it at challenge time — reply "unblock", or "highsec" for a High-Security lock (needs both players).

headline: End-game fixes: winner freed on settle, no 0-min claims, room waits before reset.
detail:
• Winner is unlocked and unbound when a deal settles.
• Can't accidentally accept a 0-minute claim.
• Room waits for the winner's "ready" before resetting (auto after ~3 min).
• Blocked padlocks handled at challenge time.

headline: Confirm settings before rolling, tidier roll messages, more end-game fixes.
detail:
• Both players confirm the agreed settings ("ready") before the first roll.
• Roll messages are one line.
• End-game leash collar is locked so it can't be slipped off; loser is fully freed when the session ends.

headline: The room is publicly listed now — plus pause/resume, paged pickers, easier !challenge.
detail:
• Room is findable (it was hidden — why it looked empty).
• !pause / !resume the bot for RP.
• Bondage/toy pickers page with "M. More".
• !challenge alone lists who's in the room; partial names work.
• End-game exclusive-lock and collar-lock fixes.

headline: New: matchmaking — !wd register, then !looking to beep online players for a game.
detail:
• !wd register joins the pool (friend the bot back so presence works).
• !looking beeps online registered players; their replies come to you.
• !wd pause / resume / status / unregister — all in !help.
• Fix: !stuck / !redress now work for "everyone except blacklist" item permissions.
